verses.text: And it came to pass in the first month, when the children of Israel went forth from Egypt, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, that the Lord spake unto Moses, saying, "Go unto this mountain, and I will give thee two tables of stone, and the law and the commandments which I have written, that thou mayest teach them."
And Moses went up unto God, and the glory of the Lord appeared unto him on Mount Sinai. And there was a cloud upon the mount for six days.

And it came to pass on the seventh day, that He called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud; and the glory of the Lord was like a devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Israel.

And Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights. And the Lord spake unto him concerning the law and the commandments, and all the matters that pertain to the people, and He showed him all the things that were to come.

Thus He said, "Upon this mountain, I will speak to thee, and thou shalt incline thine heart unto all that I shall say unto thee. For today, on this mountain, I will deliver unto thy children the statutes that I have commanded, that they may hear and observe all the ordinances that I have given."
And all these things shall be spoken unto them at the time of their coming forth. In all their doings, they shall know that I am the true God, and they shall know that I am with them.

Thou also shalt write all these words that I have spoken unto thee. For I know their anger, and I will give them a land flowing with milk and honey for their children, as I promised unto Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and I know that they shall return unto their land.

This book shall be a law unto them. For I shall command them all my statutes, and they shall follow after their iniquities, and they shall serve their idols; and in their afflictions, they shall seek me and call upon my name.

"Many shall perish, and they shall fall into the hands of their enemies. My statutes and my commandments, my covenant and my feasts, my Sabbaths, and my holy things shall be forsaken among them; my name shall be called upon them, and they shall be called my people."

In their feasts, they shall serve their idols, and they shall offer their children unto them; and they shall be consumed in their hearts with the abominations they have wrought; and I will send witnesses unto them, but they shall not hearken, and they shall slay the witnesses.
Those who transgress the law shall be put to death; they shall be cast out from their land; they shall be utterly consumed; before their eyes, they shall begin to commit evil deeds.

And I shall turn my face away from them; for their stubbornness and their wickedness, I shall deliver them into the hand of the nations; I shall protect them from the midst of Jerusalem; I shall hide them among the nations.

"All my laws, all my commandments, all my judgments, and all my statutes shall be disregarded. The appointed times of the month and the Sabbath, the feasts and the jubilee, and the statutes shall be disregarded."
After this, with their whole heart, with their whole soul, and with their whole strength, they shall return to me from among the nations. And I will gather them from among all nations.

They shall seek me, for with their whole heart and with their whole soul they shall seek me; in the time of their seeking, I will reveal to them much peace; with my whole heart and with my whole soul, I shall turn them to my righteous law.

They shall be for a blessing; they shall not be for destruction; they shall be as a head, and not as a tail; in their midst, I shall establish my sanctuary; I shall dwell among them; I shall be their God, and they shall truly be my people; for I am the Lord their God, and I shall not forsake them; I shall not abandon them.

And Moses fell upon his face and prayed, saying, "O Lord, my God, do not forsake your people, who are your inheritance; do not deliver them into the hand of their enemies, lest they be consumed by the nations."
O Lord, let your mercy be upon your people; create in them a pure heart. Before you, to be lost, let them be removed from all falsehood, that the spirit of the devil may not deceive them.

They are your people whom you have redeemed from the hand of the Egyptians; they are your inheritance and your dwelling place. Create in them a pure heart. Sanctify them with the holy spirit; from this day forth until eternity, let them not be forsaken for their sins.
And the Lord said to Moses, "I know their complaints and their thoughts; their hearts are hardened. Their sins and the sins of their fathers shall not be heard until they repent."

And after this, they shall return to Me in perfect righteousness, with perfect hearts and perfect bodies. I shall cleanse their hearts from their iniquity and their seed from their transgressions. I shall create in them a pure heart.
From that day forth, I shall deliver them, that they may not turn back from following Me until the end of the age; their hearts shall follow Me, and they shall fulfill all My commands.

I shall be their Father; and they shall be My children; all shall be called the children of the living God. All angels and all men shall know this. As they are My children, so shall I be their true and righteous Father, and as I love them, so shall they know.

You also, upon this mountain, I shall declare to you all these things, both what is before and what is behind, and all that is to come, the law and the commandments that shall be spoken in the year that shall be until the end of the age; I shall write all that shall be done with them until I dwell with them in all their generations.

The angel said to him, "From the time the world was created until the end of the age, the temple in which we shall give thanks shall be built among them, until God shall dwell with all until the end of the age, as it was written to Moses."
I am the God of Israel; I have become a Father to all the children of Jacob; I am the King of all in Mount Zion for eternity; all shall know this; Zion and Jerusalem shall be exalted.
በእስራኤል ሠራዊት ፊት የሚሄድ መልአከ ገጹም የዘመኖች አከፋፈል የተጻፈበትን ጽላት ያዘ።
ይኸውም ለሕግና ለምስክርነት በሱባዔ የሚቈጠረው የዘመኑ አከፋፈል ከዓለም ፍጥረትና አዲስ ፍጥረት ከተፈጠረበት ቀን ጀምሮ፥ ሰማያትና ምድር፥ ፍጥረታቸውም ሁሉ የሰማይ ሠራዊት እንደ መሆናቸው እስኪታደሱ ድረስ ያለው የተጻፈበት ነው።
የምድር ፍጥረት ሁሉ እንደ መሆናቸውም የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ በኢየሩሳሌምና በደብረ ጽዮን እስኪሠራ ድረስ፥ ብርሃናትም ሁሉ ከእስራኤል ለተመረጡ ሰዎች ሁሉ ለደኅንነት፥ ለሰላምና ለበረከት ሊሆኑ እስኪታደሱ ድረስ፥ ከዚህች ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዘመን ሁሉ እንደዚሁ ይሆን ዘንድ የሚደረገው ሁሉ የተጻፈበት ነው።
መልአከ ገጹም በእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሙሴን እንዲህ አለው፥ “እግዚአብሔር አምላክ በስድስተኛው ቀን ፍጥረቱን ሁሉ ፈጥሮ እንደ ጨረሰ፥ የፍጥረትን ነገር ሁሉ ጻፍ፤
በሰባተኛዪቱም ቀን እንዳረፈ፥ ከዕለታቱም ሁሉ እንደ ለያት፥ ለሥራውም ሁሉ ምልክት አድርጎ እንዳኖራት ጻፍ። በመጀመሪያዪቱ ቀን በላይ ያሉ ሰማዮችን ፈጥሮአልና፤ ምድርንና ውኃዎችንም፥ በፊቱ የሚያገለግል ፍጥረትንም ሁሉ ፈጥሮአልና።
መላእክተ ገጽንም፥ የሚያመሰግኑ መላእክትንም፥ በእሳት አካል ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትንም፥ በነፋስ አካል ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትን፥ በብርሃንና በጨለማ አካል ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትንም፥ በበረድና በውርጭ አካል ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትንም፥
በውኃ ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትን፥ በነጐድጓድና በመብረቅ ላይ የተሾሙ መላእክትን፥ በቍርና በውርጭ፥ በክረምትና በመጸው፥ በጸደይና በበጋ፥ በሰማይና በምድር ባሉ ነፋሳት ሁሉ የተሾሙ መላእክትን፥ በወንዙ ሁሉ፥ በጨለማና በብርሃን፥ በንጋትና በምሽት በባሕርይ ዕውቀቱ ባዘጋጃቸው ላይ የተሾሙ መለእክትን ፈጥሮአልና።”
ያንጊዜም ሥራውን አይተን ስለ ሠራው ሥራ ሁሉ በፊቱ ፈጽመን አመሰገንነው፤ በመጀመሪያዪቱ ቀን ሰባት ታላላቅ ሥራዎችን ሠርቶአልና።
በሁለተኛዪቱም ቀን በሐኖስና በውቅያኖስ መካከል ጠፈርን አድርጎአልና፤ በዚያችም ቀን ውኃዎች ተከፍለው እኩሌቶቹ ወደ ላይ ወጥተዋልና፤ እኵሌቶቹ ከጠፈር በታች ወዳለው ወደ ምድር መካከል ወርደዋልና፤ በሁለተኛው ቀን ይህን ሥራ ብቻ ሠራ።
በሦስተኛዪቱም ቀን፥ “ውኃዎች ከምድር ላይ ወደ አንዱ ቦታ ሄደው ይወሰኑ፥ ምድርም ትገለጥ” ብሎ እንደ ተናገረው አድርጎአልና።
And the waters were gathered together as He commanded; and they went to one place before the earth, and were confined beneath the heavens; and the earth was revealed.

On that day, He created the great sea creatures, and every living thing that moves, with which the waters swarmed, and every living creature that creeps upon the earth, and every fowl that flies, and every herb that yields seed, and every tree that bears fruit; and on the third day, He created these four great creatures.

And on the fourth day, He made the moon and the sun, and the stars also, to shine in the heavens and to give light upon the earth. He appointed the night and the day; and to distinguish between light and darkness, He set boundaries.

And God made great signs for the days and for the seasons, for the years and for the feasts, for the days that return every year, to be a great sign between light and darkness, and to separate the day from the night; and all that which is brought forth and that which is multiplied upon the earth, He created to give light; and on the fourth day, He created these three creatures.

And on the fifth day, He created the great fish of the waters and every living creature that moves in the waters. All these were created by His hand; and every flesh that is in the waters, and all the fish and the fowl, and their kinds were created.

The sun was set to give them life, and upon all creatures that dwell in this world, and upon all that which is multiplied upon the earth, and upon every tree that bears fruit, and upon every flesh that is in the waters, He set it; and on the fifth day, He created these three creatures.
And on the sixth day, He created all the beasts and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth.

And after all these things, He created man; male and female He created them; and He blessed them, and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; and have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing that moves upon the earth." On the sixth day, He created these four kinds of creatures.

All creatures of every kind were created; and on the sixth day, in heaven and on earth, in the sea and in the deep, in the midst of light and darkness, every creature that exists was made and completed.
For six days we labored, and on the seventh day we rested from all our work, and He gave the seventh day as a great sign.
All the hosts of heaven and all the angels of praise, these two are great hosts. With Him, we have been commanded to honor this in heaven and on earth.

Thus it is said, "Behold, I will separate a people from among the nations; and they shall keep the Sabbath. I will also make a people for Myself, and I will sanctify the Sabbath day as I have sanctified it before. I will also make them My people."

Thus I will sanctify them. They shall be My people; and I will be their God; for I have chosen the seed of Jacob from all that I have seen, and I have written for them a firstborn son; for eternity I have sanctified them.
"From all work they shall rest, for I will honor the day of the Sabbath. Likewise, I have made a sign for them to keep the feast."

They were with us on the seventh day for eating and drinking, to give thanks to the Lord God who created all things. And they were separated from all nations to be a visible people, blessed and sanctified.

In all generations, before Him, the good offering shall be accepted, and the sacrifices shall be made from Adam to Jacob; there are twenty-two of them. Up to the seventh day, twenty-two kinds of creatures were created. This is the blessed and sanctified Sabbath. He is blessed and holy.

This is also for thanksgiving and blessing. The former seventh day, as it was sanctified and blessed, shall be a witness and a law in all generations, that they may be blessed and sanctified; this was given to Him.

"In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth, and all the creatures that were created in six days. And the Lord gave a holy day of rest for all creation. Therefore, all who work shall die, and all who labor shall die as well."

"You shall command the children of Israel to keep this day, that they may honor it, and that no work shall be done by them, nor shall they labor; for this day is set apart, being the most holy of all days."

"All who profane it shall surely die; and all who work shall die for eternity. The children of Israel shall keep this day throughout their generations, that they may not perish from the land. For it is blessed and holy."
"Every person who observes it, and every person who rests from all their work in this time shall be regarded as holy and blessed, just as we are."

"To the children of Israel: Declare this day of judgment; let them honor it; and let them not engage in any work that is unworthy, nor let them commit any error in their hearts; let them prepare all that they may eat and drink on this day."

"And to prepare water for sanctification, and to gather all their provisions for consumption and for drinking, they shall not perform any work that they have not prepared in their homes on the sixth day."

"On the day of Jubilee, it is a day of special honor; and on this day, they shall not go out from house to house, nor shall they gather together. For they shall observe a rest on the earth, while we shall make a heavenly rest."
"The Creator of all shall bless; and He did not choose any nation other than Israel for this rest; however, He granted it solely to them, that they may observe a rest on the earth."

"This day is set apart for blessing and holiness, and for giving thanks; it is a day created by the Creator of all. This law, and this testimony, is given to the children of Israel and to their generations as an everlasting ordinance."

And on the second day, by the word of the Lord God, He brought forth all living creatures, all animals, all creeping things, and every creature that moveth upon the earth, and every creature that moveth in the waters, each according to its kind, unto Adam.

On the first day, He created the beasts; on the second day, He created the animals; on the third day, He created the creeping things; on the fourth day, all that moveth upon the earth; and on the fifth day, all that moveth in the waters. And Adam called them all by their names; and whatever name Adam called them, that was their name.
And in these five days, Adam was alone, having no creature upon the earth, male or female. He was indeed alone, for he found no helper suitable for himself.
And the Lord God said unto us, “It is not good that Adam should be alone; I will make for him a helper suitable for him.” And our God, the Lord, caused a deep sleep to fall upon him; and he slept.

And from the ribs of the man, He created a woman. This one is called Woman, for she was taken out of Man; and thus she was filled with the flesh of her own kind. And the woman was created. And He awoke Adam from his sleep.

And Adam, having awakened from his sleep, said, “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, for she was taken out of Man.” Therefore shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and they shall be one flesh.
Therefore shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave unto his wife, and they shall be one flesh.

In the beginning, Adam was created; and his wife was created from his side. And on the second day, He showed her to him; therefore, in the time of birth, for a male child, there is one birth; for a female child, there are two births, as a commandment to be observed.
And after the earth was created, Adam was placed therein for forty days, and afterward, he was taken and brought into the Garden of Eden. And his wife was also brought in on the seventh day.

And thereafter, she entered into the Garden of Eden; therefore, for a woman who gives birth, a decree is written under the heavenly ordinance. And if a male child be born, as in the first, she shall be unclean for seven days; and for a female child, she shall be unclean for fourteen days, and thirty-three days shall she be in her purification.

Do not touch anything that is holy; until the day that you have fulfilled the commandment concerning a male child, you shall not enter the house of the sanctuary. If a female child is born, as in the beginning, she shall be unclean for two weeks; she shall remain unclean for two weeks in her purification. She shall be unclean for sixty-six days. All shall be eighty days.
And when she has completed these eighty days, she shall be consecrated, for she is holy unto the Lord; and all that is within her shall be holy, and she shall be brought into the garden of Eden.

Therefore, for the male child and the female child, the ordinance of these days is established; for the male child and for the female child, until these days are completed, do not touch anything that is holy; nor shall you enter the sanctuary. And Israel shall observe this throughout their generations, for this is the law and the ordinance that is written.

In the beginning, in the first jubilee, Adam and his wife dwelt in the garden of Eden for seven years, and they kept the law. And they were given work to do; to serve and to guard all the work that was visible, they remained in it; and he was working.
But he was in the flesh; and he did not know how it was, nor did he perceive it. He was to guard the trees and the beasts, and all the creatures.

And he would eat the fruit that was ripe, and he would gather what was fallen for himself and for his wife; and he would guard what was to be guarded; for seven years he would diligently keep it, until the time of their completion.

In the second month, on the seventeenth day, a serpent came and approached Eve. And the serpent said to Eve, “Of all the trees in the garden, the Lord God said, ‘Do not eat of them,’ has He not commanded you?”
And she said to him, “The Lord God said, ‘Of all the fruit of the trees in the garden you may eat, but of the fruit of the tree that is in the midst of the garden, you shall not eat, lest you die.’”
And the serpent said to Eve, “On the day you eat of it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like gods, knowing good and evil; for God knows that when you eat of it, you will not die.”

And Eve saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree desirable to make one wise. And she took of its fruit and ate; and she also gave to her husband with her, and he ate. And their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves loincloths.
And the Lord hearkened unto the plea; for He had decreed it for eternity.

And she, having heard the words of the serpent, said, “I shall greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow shalt thou bring forth children, and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.”

And Adam said, “If thou dost hearken to the words of thy wife and eat of the tree of which I commanded thee, saying, ‘Thou shalt not eat of it,’ then the ground shall be cursed for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life; thou shalt return to the ground, for out of it wast thou taken; for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.”
And he made for them garments of skins; and he clothed them, and they were driven from the garden of Eden.

And on that day, Adam went forth from the garden of Eden, adorned with goodly garments, white linen, and a heart full of joy; and as he emerged in the morning, when the sun shone forth, he was blessed.

And on that day, all the beasts of the field and every living creature, that which crawls and that which flies, were forbidden to speak. Before this, they used to converse with one another in one voice and in one tongue.
All flesh that dwelt in the garden of Eden was gathered from the garden of Eden.
Every flesh was gathered according to its kind and according to its nature, and they were assembled unto the place where they were created.

For Adam alone was set apart from all the beasts and from all living creatures; he was given garments to cover his nakedness. Therefore, the judgment of the law was commanded upon all who knew it, that they should cover their nakedness, lest the nations be made manifest in heaven.
In the fourth month, Adam and his wife departed from the garden of Eden and dwelt in the land of Eldah. And Adam did not call his wife's name Eve; for until the first Jubilees, they had no children.
And after this, in the days of the harvest, he was indeed as one who had learned the land of Eden.
In the third jubilee, she bore Cain in the second jubilee; and in the fourth jubilee, she bore Abel; and in the fifth jubilee, she bore her son, Awan.

The Lord accepted the offerings from Abel's hand, but from Cain's hand, He did not accept the offerings. Therefore, in the third jubilee, Cain killed Abel; in the wilderness, he was slain; and because he was slain, his blood cried out from the earth unto heaven.
And the Lord, concerning the slaying of Abel, spoke unto Cain, saying, "The blood of your brother Abel cries out to Me from the ground," and it was heard upon the earth.

Therefore, he who slays his brother in secret is as one who is accursed, and in heaven, his name is written down. Let all who see it say, "Amen." Let him who has not spoken be as one who is accursed like him.

Therefore, we, in heaven and on earth, in light and in darkness, shall speak of all the sins that are committed before our God, the Lord; for Adam and his wife were as they mourned for Abel, four generations long.

And Adam was glad in the fifth generation, in the fourth year; and he knew his wife by the act of love; and a son was born to him. "For Cain has slain Abel, and the Lord has caused another seed to rise up for us upon the earth," he said, and he named him a daughter.
In the sixth generation, he begot a son, and Cain took his sister to be his wife; and in the fourth year, she bore him Enoch.
In the fifth generation, in the first year, houses were built upon the earth. And Cain built a city; and he called its name after his son Enoch.
And Adam knew his wife Eve by the act of love. And again, she bore him nine children.
And in the fifth generation, in the fifth year, she took her sister to be his wife.
And in the fourth year, she bore him Henoah. He was the first to begin to call upon the name of the Lord upon the earth.
In the seventh generation, in the third year, Henoah became his wife, and in the fifth year, in the third year, a son was born to him; and he named him Cain.

In the eighth generation, at the end, he took his sister Mu'alilit to be his wife; and in the ninth generation, in the first year, in this year, in the third year, a son was born to him; and he named him Melaleel.

In the tenth jubilee, in the second suba, she became the wife of Melaleel, and she bore a son named Dinah, the son of her father’s brother, the son of Barakheel. And in the third suba, in the sixth year, she bore a male child, and his name was Jarod. In his time, the angels of the Lord, who are called the Watchers, instructed the children of men upon the earth, and they executed judgment and righteousness upon the earth, for they descended to the earth.
And Jarod also took a wife in the first jubilee; her name was Barakah; she was the daughter of his father.
And the people, according to their seasons, knew the times of the generations, and according to their seasons, they wrote the sign of heaven in the book.

And he also wrote beforehand a witness. For the children of men, according to their generations, he wrote; and he spoke of the numbers that are counted in the subas; and he spoke of the days of the generations; and he made months; and we also, as it is our custom, spoke of the subas that are counted in the generations. The judgment that was done and that will yet be done, until the day when it shall be executed, he saw in vision upon the children of men, both that which has been and that which shall be, he beheld the night.
And for a witness, he wrote. And upon all the children of men, according to their births, he was appointed to be a witness upon the earth.
In the second jubilee, in the seventh suba, he took a wife. Her name was Adni; she was the daughter of Daniel, the sister of his father; and he took her to be his wife.
And in this suba, in the sixth year, she bore a male child, and his name was Mathusala.
After this, he lived with the angels of God for six jubilee periods. And upon the earth, he showed all that is therein, and in heaven, he showed the power of the sun.

He wrote all things. With the children of men, he became one in sin, and in wickedness, they acted, and they led them astray. These shall be joined with the children of men, that they may be one in transgression, for they began it; and Enoch also led them astray.

And among the children of men, he was chosen. For nobility and honor, he was taken to the garden of Eden; behold, he shall there receive the eternal curse and the judgment of wickedness, and the sins of the children of Adam shall be written upon him.

For every man who hears the son, until the day when judgment is executed upon him, all the work of man shall be spoken of, for he has been given as a sign, and concerning him, upon the land of Edom, all the waters of destruction have been brought forth.

And he, the Lord God, received the offering upon the altar, and he offered it upon the holy mountain; for the Lord has four places upon the earth, and these are the garden of Edom and the mount of olives, and this is today the mount Sinai that you dwell within, and for the deliverance of the earth, it is the new creation that is being delivered.
Therefore, the earth shall be delivered from all wickedness and iniquity for the generation of the children.
In the forty-eighth year, he took his wife, and she was of the daughter of his father's sister, the daughter of Israel.
In the sixth year, he begot a son in the first generation. And his name was called Lamah.
In the fifty-fifth year, he took a wife from the third generation, and her name was Betenas; she was the daughter of his father's sister, the daughter of Berakim; and she was taken to be his wife.
And thus she bore a son, and she called his name Noah, saying, "This one will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord has cursed."
In the twenty-seventh jubilee, in the seventh week, in the sixth year, Adam died. And all his children buried him in the land where he had been created.
And he had been buried in the earth for seven years, and this was as a witness in heaven as if it had been one day.

"On the day that you eat of it, you shall surely die," it has been said; and thus, it was written concerning the tree of knowledge, for she has died in her own death, and therefore the years of one day were not completed.

And in this jubilee, at the end of one year, Cain died; and his house was burned; and within his house, he died by the stones. Abel was killed by the stone, and truly he died by the stone of judgment.
Therefore, a man shall die by the instrument with which he kills his neighbor, as it has been decreed; and in heaven, it has been written.
In the fiftieth jubilee, Noah took a wife. Her name was Amzarah. This one also...
In the first year, in the sixth week, she bore a son named Japheth.

The children of Adam multiplied upon the earth; and when they began, it was so: daughters were born to them. And the angels of the Lord beheld them in this jubilee in one of the years; and they were fair to behold, and from all those whom they chose, they took wives for themselves; and the sons also bore sons.

Sin also increased upon the earth; and flesh was corrupted from all men, from the beginning of man to the beasts and to the creeping things and to the birds, and upon the earth, all that dwelt therein corrupted their ways. All their paths and their laws were corrupted. They devoured one another, and sin increased upon the earth. And the thoughts of all men were evil continually in their days.

And the Lord looked upon the earth; and behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth. And He said, "I will destroy man and every living thing that I have made upon the face of the earth."

But Noah found grace in the sight of the Lord. And the angels that were sent to the earth were angry; and they commanded that they be utterly destroyed, separating them from their dominion. And they were commanded to be cast into the depths of the earth.
And behold, they were consumed among themselves; they were left alone. And from before Him, they were destroyed by the sword; and from beneath the heavens, a word went forth against their children.
"For they are fleshly beings, and my spirit shall not strive with man forever. Let their days be a hundred and twenty years," He said.

Each one of them killed their neighbors with the sword among themselves. And all began to slay one another until they were destroyed by the sword; and they perished from the earth; but their fathers were remembered.

After this, their paths were made to be a judgment upon all until the great day of judgment shall come, and they were engulfed in the depths of the earth. Their works were before the Lord; and from their place, all were destroyed, and from their iniquities, not one remained unpunished.
That they should not perish in their creation until the end of the world, all were given new and true creation to perform righteous works in their generation.
The judgment of all was prepared, and in heaven, a decree was written without measure. All were to remain steadfast, for they were those who had departed from the works that were created for them.

And even if they do not remain steadfast, a judgment was written for every creation, for each of their kind. In heaven and on earth, in light and in darkness, in Sheol and in the depths, there is nothing that is not accounted for.

Their judgment was prepared, and it was both established and written. Therefore, the great shall be judged according to their greatness, and the small according to their smallness; each shall be judged according to their iniquity.

He does not show partiality, nor does He take bribes. For each one, He will judge at the appointed time; He does not accept a bribe, and if anyone on earth were to give Him all that he has, He would not show partiality. For He is a judge of truth, and He does not accept a bribe from Him.
This was written and established concerning the children of Israel. Indeed, when they return to Him, He will forgive them all their iniquities. He will also cleanse them of all their sins.

All those who have returned from their iniquities shall be forgiven once a year, as it is written. Before the flood, it was written concerning those who had perished, that all their transgressions and their counsel were blotted out.

Because of Him, the children who were saved from the flood have found grace, and apart from Noah, they have not found grace. Concerning Him, as it was commanded, in all His ways, His heart is true, and He does not depart from all the laws He has established.
And the Lord said, “Everything that is on the earth, from man to beast, from creeping thing to fowl, and everything that moves upon the earth, shall be destroyed.”
To save him from the flood, He commanded Noah to build an ark for him.
Noah also built the ark in the second jubilee, in the fifth week, in the fifth year, as it was commanded.
In the sixth year, in the second month, until the sixteenth day, he entered. And all that was to be brought to the ark entered.

And the Lord, on the seventeenth day of the tenth month, caused the ark to rest upon the mountains of Ararat; and the Lord opened the fountains of the great deep and the windows of heaven, and the rain was upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
And the fountains were opened from heaven for forty days and forty nights, and they began to pour down rain.
የጥልቁም ምንጮች ዓለሙ ሁሉ ውኃን እስኪሞላ ድረስ ውኃዎችን ያወጡ ነበር፤ ውኃዎችም በምድር ላይ በዙ፤ ውኃውም በረጅሙ ተራራ ሁሉ ላይ ዐሥራ አምስት ክንድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ።
ውኃዎችም ከፍ ከፍ አሉ። መርከቢቱም በምድር ላይ ከፍ ከፍ አለች። በውኃውም ላይ ትመላለስ ነበር፤ ውኃዎችም በምድር ላይ አምስት ወር ማለት መቶ አምሳ ቀን ቈዩ። መርከቢቱም ሄደች፥ ከአራራት ተራራዎችም በአንዱ ሉባር በሚባል ተራራ ራስ ላይ ዐረፈች።
በአራተኛውም ወር ሰፊ የሆነ የጥልቁ ምንጮች ተገቱ። የሰማዩም ሻሻቴ ተገታ።
በሰባተኛውም ወር መባቻ የምድሩ ጥልቅ አፍ ሁሉ ተከፈተ። ውኃዎችም ወደ ታችኛዪቱ ጥልቅ ይወርዱ ጀመር።

In the tenth month, the tops of the mountains were seen; in the first month, the earth was revealed; and the waters were dried up from the earth in the fifth month, in the seventh year. And on the seventeenth day of the second month, the earth was dried up.

On the seventeenth day of the month, the ark was opened; and from within it, all the beasts and birds, and everything that moved, were sent away. In the third month, Noah went out of the ark. And thus, he built an altar upon the mountain; and he consecrated the earth. All that remained with Noah in the ark perished, and the blood of the sacrifice atoned for all the sins of the earth.

And he offered upon the altar. He brought forth the fowl and the sheep, the salt, the fat, and the wine, and he offered them upon the altar. And he added the offerings that were anointed with oil upon them.
He brought forth the blood and the wine, and upon all, he poured out the drink offering. And the Lord accepted the good offering that was presented.

And the Lord accepted the good offering; and He made a covenant with Him that the waters of destruction should not destroy the earth. Thus He said, “While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest shall not cease; cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall not cease. They shall not be cut off for all generations.”

“And you shall be fruitful, and multiply greatly upon the earth, and above it shall be many; and for blessing shall you be; for from you shall I bring forth fear and dread upon all that dwell upon the earth and in the sea.”
Behold, I have given you all the beasts and cattle, and every creeping thing that moves upon the earth and in the sea; you shall eat them all for sustenance.

However, you shall not eat flesh with the lifeblood still in it, for the lifeblood is the seat of the soul; and do not let your blood be shed among your kindred, for I will surely require it. For the blood of man I will require; and the blood of man shall be shed, for God created man in His own image, and you shall be many; and upon the earth shall you multiply greatly.”
Noah and his sons were commanded not to eat any flesh with the lifeblood still in it. In this time, a covenant was established before the Lord, the eternal God.
Therefore, “You shall be fruitful and multiply.”
በምድርም ዘመን ሁሉ የወፎችንና የአውሬዎችን ሥጋ ሁሉ እንዳትበሉ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ትጠብቁአት ዘንድ ይህች ምስክር በእናንተ ላይ የተጻፈች ናት።
በምድርም ዘመን ሁሉ የአውሬውን፥ የከብቶችንና የወፎችን ሥጋ ብርንዶውን የበላ ሰው እርሱና ዘሩ ከምድር ይጠፋሉ።
አንተም በዘመኑ ሁሉ በአምላካችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስማቸውና ዘራቸው ጸንቶ ይኖር ዘንድ ብርንዶውን ሁሉ እንዳይበሉ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው።
በቀኑ ሁሉ በመሠዊያው አንጻር በደም ስለ እናንተ እየለመኑ እንዲኖሩ ለልጅ ልጅ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ የዘለዓለም ሕግ ነውና ለዚህ ሕግ የዘመን ፍጻሜ የለውም። ይጠብቁትም ዘንድ እንዳይጠፉ ማታና ጥዋት ስለ እነርሱ ሁልጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ኀጢአታቸውን ያስተሰርያሉ።
“ዳግመኛም በምድር ላይ ጥፋት እንዳይሆን ለኖኅና ለልጆቹ የቃል ኪዳኑን ምልክት ሰጣቸው፤ እርስዋንም ዳግመኛ ለማጥፋት በዘመኑ ሁሉ በምድር ላይ የጥፋት ውኃ እንዳይሆን ለዘለዓለም ለቃል ኪዳኑ ምልክት ቀስቱን በደመና ውስጥ ሰጠ።
“ስለዚህም በዘመኑ ሁሉ ለአዲስ ኪዳን በየዓመቱ አንድ ጊዜ በዚህ ወር የሱባዔያትን በዓል የሚያደርጉ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ተሠራ፤ በሰማይ ጽላትም ተጻፈ።
ይህችም በዓል ከፍጥረት ቀን ጀምሮ እስከ ኖኅ ዘመን ድረስ በሰማይ ስትሠራ ኖረች፤ ይኸውም ሃያ ሰባት ኢዮቤልዩና አምስት የዓመት ሱባዔ ነው። ኖኅና ልጆቹም፥ ኖኅ እስከሚሞትባት ቀን ድረስ ሰባት ኢዮቤልዩና አንድ የዓመት ሱባዔ ጠበቁት።
ኖኅ ከሞተ በኋላም እስከ አብርሃም ዘመን ድረስ ልጆቹ ሕግን አፈረሱ፤ ብርንዶውንም በሉ። ነገር ግን አብርሃም ብቻ ሕግን ጠበቀ፤ ይስሐቅና ያዕቆብም እስከ አንተ ዘመን ድረስ ጠበቁት። በዘመንህም በዚህ ተራራ እስካድሳቸው ድረስ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሕግን ዘነጉ።
አንተም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው፤ ይህችንም በዓል በትውልዳቸው ሁሉ ለእነርሱ እንደ ታዘዘ ይጠብቁአት። በሱባዔ የምትደረግ በዓል ናትና በዓመት አንድ ቀን በዚህ ወር ይህችን በዓል ያድርጉ።
የመጀመሪያውም አዝመራ የሚሰበሰብባት በዓል ናትና። ይህችውም ሁለት ቀን በዓል የሚያደርጉባት ሁለት አይነት በዓል ናት። በየጊዜዋም ታደርጋት ዘንድ በጻፍሁልህ በዚህ በመጀመሪያው የሕግ መጽሐፍ ጽፌልሃለሁና ስለ እርስዋ ሥራዋ እንደ ተጻፈና እንደ ተቀረፀ ከዓመት አንድ ቀን ጠብቃት።
Let them be remembered, that the children of Israel shall observe for each of their generations, on this month, one day each year, to make their offerings.

"In the first month, on the fourteenth day; in the second month, on the fourteenth day; in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day; in the tenth month, on the fourteenth day; these are the days of remembrance. In the fourth part of the year, they are days that have time assigned to them; these also..."
Noah, until they became a remembrance for him, established the feasts for his descendants, for generation upon generation, forever.
In the first month, it was said that he should prepare his own vessel; and the earth was dry; and he opened the window and looked upon the earth.
In the fourth month, the mouth of the deep was opened. The heavens also were torn apart.
In the seventh month, all the springs of the great deep were broken up; and the waters began to descend into the deep.

In the tenth month, the tops of the mountains were seen, and Noah was glad; therefore, he established the feasts for them as a remembrance until the end of the world. These were made thus; and they ascended to heaven as a memorial.

And each of them, from this remembrance to that remembrance, from the first to the second, from the second to the third, from the third to the fourth, until the thirteenth, are thirty-three in number.

All the days of the commandments shall be counted as fifty-two. The complete year shall thus be established and counted, and in heaven, it shall be recorded. One year and two years, three years shall not be passed over.

You also shall keep for the children of Israel in this year, in this number, three hundred sixty-four days; let them be complete years. And let them not neglect the time of the day and the feast. Let them not fail to observe their testimony, for the day shall not be missed; nor shall the feast be neglected.
Though they may wander, if they do not obey His command, at that time all their days shall be consumed.

And the years shall change from this to that; the times shall be consumed; the years shall change; their ordinances shall be broken; and all the children of Israel shall be scattered. They shall not find the way of the years; they shall forget their memorial; they shall break the time and the seasons, and all the ordinances of the age shall be broken.

I know, therefore I will speak to you henceforth; for such a book has been written before me, and what I speak to you is not from my heart; lest, after the time has passed, they forget the covenant of the word, and that they do not go to the feasts of the nations, the division of the age has been written in the heavens.
"For she shall change the times, and from the years she shall advance ten days; those who regard the moon shall be.

Therefore, after they have departed from the ordinance, the years shall come upon them; they shall make a day of testimony as one that has been broken. They shall celebrate the day of her blessing; they shall all be gathered; they shall sanctify the days that are blessed, and the days that are blessed shall be made holy; the months and the seasons, the feasts and the new moons shall be observed.

Therefore, I command you; your children, after your death, shall not observe the year for three hundred sixty-four days only, for they shall change the ordinance, and I have commanded you to be merciful toward them.
Therefore, they shall observe the months and the seasons, the times and the feasts; they shall eat with all men and shall consume all the bread."
In this Jubilee, in the seventh month, in the first year, when the Ark was brought forth, Noah planted a vineyard upon one of the mountains called Lubar among the mountains of Ararat.

And in the eighth year, he harvested; and he kept its fruit; and in that year, in the seventh month, he preserved its fruit. From it, he made wine and stored it in vessels, until the fifth year, until the beginning of the first month, he kept it.

On this day, he made a feast with joy, and offered sacrifices unto the Lord. He also made atonement for his own sin, and offered one of the lambs, and a ram, and seven good goats, which were a year old, and one young goat.

Concerning his sons, he first offered a goat; and he placed its flesh upon the altar that was in the sanctuary with its blood. And he offered the sacrifices upon the altar, and placed all the fat upon the altar. He placed the ram and the lambs, and all their flesh upon the altar. And he placed all their offerings that were mingled with oil upon them.

After this, he poured out wine upon the fire that was upon the altar. He first placed his burnt offering upon the altar; and the Lord accepted the good offerings. And the offerings ascended to his God, to the Lord, and he was glad with wine. And his sons were also glad.
In the time of evening, he went into his tent and slept; and while he was sleeping in his tent, he uncovered his nakedness.
And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and went outside to tell his two brothers.

Shem also arose, and took his garment, and he and Japheth took a garment and laid it upon their shoulders, and walked backward, and covered the nakedness of their father, and their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
And Noah awoke from his sleep, and knew what his younger son had done unto him, and he said, “Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.”
And he said, “Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant. God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.”
ካምም አባቱ ታናሹን ልጁን እንደ ረገመው ዐወቀ። ልጁንም ረግሞታልና ለእርሱ ክፉ ነገር ሆነበት፤ እርሱም ከአባቱ ተለየ፤ ልጆቹም ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ። እነዚህም ኩሽና ሜስራይም፥ ፉጥና ከነዓን ናቸው። እርሱም ከተማን አቀና፤ የከተማዪቱንም ስም በሚስቱ ስም አኤልታማክ ብሎ ጠራት።
ያፌትም አይቶ በወንድሙ ቀና፤ እርሱም ከተማን አቀና፤ ስምዋንም በሚስቱ ስም አዶታኔስስ ብሎ ጠራት።
ሴም ግን ከአባቱ ከኖኅ ጋር ተቀመጠ፤ በአባቱም እጅ በተራራው ላይ ከተማን አቀና፤ እርሱም ስምዋን በሚስቱ በሴዴቄተልባብ ስም ጠራ።
እነዚህም ሦስቱ ከተሞች፥ እነሆ፥ በሉባር ተራራ አቅራቢያ ናቸው። ሴዴቄተልባብም በተራራው አንጻር በምሥራቅ ናት፥ አኤልታማክም በሰሜን አንጻር ናት፤ አዶታኒስስም በምዕራብ ናት።
የሴምም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፥ ኤላምና አሱር፥ አርፋክስድም ሉድና አራምም፥ እነዚህ የጥፋት ውኃ ከሆነበት ከአራተኛው ዓመት በኋላ የተወለዱ ናቸው። ያፌትም ጎሜርንና ማጎግን፥ ያዋንንና ቶቤልን፥ ሞሳክንና ቴራስን ወለደ። እነዚህ ሁሉ የኖኅ ልጆች ናቸው።

ኖኅም በሃያ ስምንተኛው ኢዮቤልዩ ለልጅ ልጆቹ ሥርዐትንና ትእዛዝን፥ የሚያውቀውንም ፍርድ ሁሉ ያዝዝ ጀመረ። እውነትንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ የሰውነታቸውንም ኀፍረት ይሸፍኑ ዘንድ፥ የፈጠራቸው እግዚአብሔርንም ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ፥ አባትና እናታቸውንም ያከብሩ ዘንድ፥ እያንዳንዳቸውም ባልንጀራቸውን ይወድዱ ዘንድ፥ ሰውነታቸውንም ከዝሙትና ከርኵሰት፥ ከበደልም ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ያዝዛቸው ጀመር።
ትጉሃን ከታዘዘላቸው ሕግ ወጥተው ከሰው ልጆች ጋር ስላደረጉት ዝሙት በእነዚህ በሦስቱ ኀጢአቶች በምድር ላይ የጥፋት ውኃ ተደርጎአልና።
ከመረጡአቸው ሴቶችም ሁሉ ሚስቶችን አገቡ፥ አስቀድመውም ርኵሰትን ሠሩ። ኀይለኞች ልጆችንም ወለዱ፤ ሁሉም አይመሳሰሉም ነበሩ።

እያንዳንዱም ባልንጀራውን ይበላው ነበር። አርበኛውም ናፊልን ገደለው፤ ናፊልም ኢልዮንን ገደለው፥ ኢልዮንም የሰውን ልጅ ገደለው። ሰውም ባልንጀራውን ገደለው፤ ሁሉም ዐመፅን ያደርግ ዘንድ፥ ንጹሕ ደምንም ያፈስስ ዘንድ ተመለሰ። ምድርም ዐመፅን ተሞላች፥ ከእነዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ በአውሬዎችና በወፎች፥ በምድር ላይም በሚንቀሳቀሰውና በሚመላለሰው ሁሉ ላይ በደሉ።
በምድርም ላይ ብዙ ደም ፈሰሰ፤ የሰውም ልቡናውና ፈቃዱ በዘመኑ ሁሉ ከንቱና ክፉ ነገርን ያስቡ ጀመር።

And the Lord, because of their evil deeds, destroyed all before Him upon the earth. And upon the earth, because of the blood they shed, He made all to be consumed; "I and you, O children, all who entered the ark with us shall perish."

Because of your wicked deeds, you have begun to dwell in destruction, and behold, you are not truly dwelling in righteousness; lo, I have seen your former works. Each of you shall be separated from your neighbor; and among yourselves, you shall be divided.
O children, as you do not dwell in unity with one another, so I will not be with you; behold, I will bring calamity upon you and upon your children.

Even now, after your death, you shall shed the blood of man upon the earth; and you shall perish from the face of the earth, for I fear for you. All who shed the blood of man and all who consume flesh shall be cut off from this world; for all who consume flesh and shed blood shall not remain in this world.

They shall go to the grave, and they shall descend to Sheol where judgment is; all shall be seized by wicked death and shall be cast into the deep darkness, for beneath the heavens, neither child nor grandchild shall remain alive.
"Any beast and any creature that roams upon the earth, when you shed its blood, in your days, no blood shall be upon you."

The blood that is shed upon the earth shall be a witness against your bodies; do not partake with it. Let others beware that blood does not befall you; for I shall command you thus, and let your blood be upon you.

I shall make a covenant with you and your children with all flesh. Let not your blood be mingled with the blood of any man upon the earth; let not your soul be consumed with flesh; for in every generation upon the earth, the blood that is shed shall not be cleansed.
"Now, O children, hear me; that you may dwell in truth before the Lord upon the earth, and that your glory may be revealed before your God, let judgment and righteousness be your plea."

Behold, you shall depart from the cities; and within them, you shall uproot every plant that is upon the earth. Every plant shall be for the third year, and it shall be a fruit that is not to be withheld from eating.

In the fourth year, its fruit shall be sanctified; before the face of the Most High God, who created the heavens and the earth, they shall offer the first of its fruit, the first of the vine and the oil, as the first of the harvest, in the sanctuary of the Lord, with a spirit of generosity; and the servants of the house of the Lord shall eat of the offering that is received before the sanctuary.

And you shall truly and rightly observe the rest in the fifth year; and you shall honor it; and all that you plant shall be for your benefit. For your father’s father, Enoch, commanded thus; and Methuselah, his son, commanded thus; and Lamech, your father, has commanded all that your forefathers have commanded to me.

And I, O children, shall command you as Enoch commanded his son; for in the first jubilee, while he was alive, in the seventh generation, Methuselah until the day he died, commanded his sons and the sons of his sons.

In the twenty-seventh jubilee, in the first year, Subea, in the first year, took a wife; and her name was Rasueya; and she was the daughter of Elam, the daughter of Susana. In the third year, she bore a son to this Subea; and his name was Qayin; and he was evil; and his father taught him the scriptures.

And he sought a place to dwell in the city; and he found the book that the former men had left behind in stone. And he read therein, and it was interpreted. The sun and the moon, and all the stars of heaven, were signs that were taught in it, for all the teachings of the heavens were in it, as it was written therein.
And he wrote, yet he did not speak of her. For he feared to speak of her lest she be angry with him.
In the thirty-third jubilee, in the second Subea, in the first year, he took a wife; and her name was Melka; and she was the daughter of Japheth, the daughter of Abedai.

In the fourth year, she bore a son; and his name was Sala; and he said, “I have sent a message;” and he was evil; and in the thirty-first jubilee, in the fifth Subea, in the first year, he took a wife; and her name was Muak; and she was the daughter of his father’s brother, the daughter of Kessed.

In the fifth year, she bore a son; and his name was Ebor. And he, in the thirty-second jubilee, in the seventh Subea, in the third year, took a wife; and her name was Azurad; and she was the daughter of Abrod.

In the sixth year, she bore a son; and his name was Phalek; for in the time he was born, the children of Noah began to divide the earth; therefore he called his name Phalek; and they divided it among themselves, and they told it to Noah.

And in the thirty-third year, it came to pass that the beginning was as follows: To Ham, and to Shem, and to Japheth, an inheritance was to be given; from the first Subea, in the first year, it was sent to them, and one of us who possessed the land was to divide it into three; and he called his sons, and they and their sons drew near to him; and the three sons desired the land that was to be divided.

And they took their hands and received the book from the hand of their father Noah. The inheritance that was to be possessed by Shem's descendants was written in the book, and it went forth among the children of the earth. From the mountains of the Arba, beginning from the exit of the waters, it went forth until the river Tigris.

And its portion shall reach to the west of this river; and this river shall flow from her until it reaches the great water, until it comes to the great sea; and the water shall flow to the sea of Meot; and this river shall flow until it reaches the great sea; and all the land that is to the south shall be allotted to Japheth; and all the land that is to the north shall be allotted to Shem.

And it shall flow until it reaches the Koras; and this shall be the language of the north. And its portion shall reach to the great sea. This sea is called the sea of Egypt, and it shall flow until it reaches the entrance of the language.

And from there it shall turn to the north; and it shall reach the entrance of the great sea and the shore of the water; and it shall reach the left of the Afra; and the flowing water shall reach until it comes to the Gion; and it shall flow to the Gion and reach this flowing shore.

And it shall flow to the garden of Eden and to the north until it reaches the right, and to the east it shall go; from the land of Edom, all to the east, from all the land it shall return to the east. It shall come to the mountain called Raphah until it reaches, and it shall descend to the exit of the river Tigris.
This portion is for the everlasting inheritance of Shem and his sons, and for the sons of his sons, until the end of the world, it shall go forth in inheritance.

Noah was glad, for this portion is the inheritance of Shem and his sons. “Blessed be the God of Shem, and let God dwell in the tents of Shem,” he said, and he remembered all that was spoken by his mouth in prophecy. The land of Edom was honored, for it has been honored; and the dwelling of God has been established.

He who caused the angel to speak with his mouth, let him be praised until the end of the world; blessed is this portion and blessing for Shem and his sons, for the sons of his sons, until the end of the world, as it has been established.

All the land of Edom, and all the shore of the sea of Eritrea, and all the land of the east, which is in Eritrea and the mountains, and all the land of Bashan, and all the land of Lebanon, and all the islands of the sea, and all the mountains of the south, and all the land of Elam, and Assyria, and Babylon, and all the land of Susiana and the land of the Ararat, all these shall be known as blessed and wide, and within it shall be all that is good.

And the second river went forth to Gihon, and it flowed to the east of the garden, and it reached the north. And it flowed to the mountain of the land of the north; and all the mountains of the land shall reach it; and it shall reach to the west. And it shall reach to the center of the sea until it draws near to the sea, and it shall reach to the west. This is the land that shall perish, and it is the land that shall descend to itself. And it shall go forth to the south and to the gate of the south. And it shall flow to Gihon until it draws near to the sea, and it shall come to the great sea.

The river that is called Gihon shall flow in the land of Edom until it draws near. For eternity, for those who possess it, for the land of Ham and for its children, for their kindred, until eternity, this is the land that has gone forth by the river.

And for Japheth, the third river went forth. It flowed to the east to the waters of the sea, and it went forth to the south. And to the south, it reached the east, and to the region of Gog, and all the regions of the east shall reach it, from the south to the south it shall reach. And it shall reach the mountain of Kelt, and to the south, and to the sea of Maluq it shall reach. Until the outlet of the sea, it shall reach to the gate of the east.

For eternity, this is the land that shall possess the river, for Japheth and for his children, for their kindred, this is the land that has gone forth. Its great islands are five. The land that lies to the south is wide. However, the land of Japheth is cold; the land of Ham is a desert; but the land of Shem is mixed with the sea and the river, and it is not a barren land.
Ham divided among his children. The first river went forth to Cush to the south, the west to Mizraim, and the west to Put; the west to Canaan; and on the west side was the sea.

Shem also divided among his children. The first river went forth to Elam and his children until the land of Hindekel, all the east until it draws near to the river of Tigris to the east; and Eritrea was in his hand. The waters of Didan, the mountains of Mobri, all the land of Elam, all the land of Susam, all that is near to Fironok, until the sea of Eritrea and until the river of Tigris.
For Asshur, the second river went forth; all the land of Assyria and Nineveh, and Senaar, and it shall reach until the land of Hindekel.

For Arphaxad, the third river went forth. All the land of the region of Kelawde, the land that is near to the sea of Eritrea, and to Egypt until it looks toward the sea of Lisan, until the waters of the wilderness, all the waters, the land of Lebanon, and the land of Sanir, and Amana, until the land of Ephrath.
For Aram, the fourth river went forth; between Tigris and Euphrates, all the land of Mesopotamia, to the south of Kelawde until it reaches the region of Asshur, all the land of Ararat is his.

For Lud, the fifth river went forth; all the mountains of Assyria, and it shall reach until it draws near to the great sea, and it is his river. And it shall reach to his brother, to Asshur in the east.

And Japheth desired the land of his inheritance among his sons. And the first portion was from the south, beginning from the river of Gihon, even unto the river of Tigris, towards the east, for Shem. And in the south, all the region round about the southern sea, even unto the borders of the land of Magog.
From the east, even unto the islands and unto the borders of the islands, for both of the brothers, it was given as an inheritance to the sons of the mighty.
And for Joah, the fourth portion was given, even all the islands, and all the islands that are near Lud.
And for Tobel, even unto the second language, the portion was given, and the fifth portion was given among the languages that are near Lud. And the second language is until the third language.
And for Mosak, the sixth portion was given. Even unto the eastern borders of Gader, the third language is all the region.

And for Tiras, the seventh portion was given. In the midst of the sea, there are the great four islands that are near Kam; and the islands of the Khamathites were given as an inheritance to the sons of Arphaxad; and the sons of Noah, for their sons, before their father Noah, thus they did as they desired. And let each one take the portion that he has not received, as he desires, and let it be measured.

Let it be so for all. Because of their iniquities, all their evil deeds, the earth is filled with wickedness and iniquity; and because of their transgressions and sins, for they are full, the Lord God shall judge them with the sword and with fire, until the day of judgment, even upon themselves and upon their children, and upon their descendants, even unto eternity, let it be so.
በዚህ ኢዮቤልዩ በሦስተኛው ሱባዔ ርኩሳን አጋንንት የኖኅን የልጅ ልጆች ያስቱአቸውና አእምሮአቸውን እያሳጡ ያጠፉአቸው ጀመሩ።
የኖኅም ልጆች ወደ አባታቸው ወደ ኖኅ መጡ። የልጅ ልጆቹንም የሚያስቱና የሚያደነቁሩ፥ የሚገድሉም የአጋንንትን ነገር ነገሩት።

ኖኅም ወደ ፈጣሪው ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ሲል ጸለየ፥ “ምሕረትህን አድርገህ ያዳንኸኝ፥ ልጆችንም ከጥፋት ውኃ ያዳንኻቸው፥ የጥፋትን ልጅ እንዳጠፋኸው እንድጠፋ ያላደረግኸኝ፥ በእኔ ላይ ያለ ይቅርታህ ብዙ ነውና፥ ቸርነትህም በሰውነቴ በዝታለችና፥ በሥጋ ውስጥ ሁሉ ያሉ የነፍሳት ፈጣሪ ሆይ፥ ይቅርታህ በልጆች ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ይበል፤ ክፉዎች አጋንንትም ከዚህ ዓለም እንዳያጠፉአቸው በላያቸው አይሠልጥኑ።

አንተም እኔን ባርከኝ። የብዙ ብዙ እንሆን ዘንድ፥ ምድርንም እንሞላት ዘንድ፥ ልጆችን ባርካቸው። አንተም በሕይወት ያሉ የእነዚህ ረቂቃን አጋንንት አባቶቻቸው ትጉሃን ያደረጉትን ታውቃለህ። ይዘህ በፍርድ ቦታ አግዛቸው፤ እነርሱ ክፉዎች ናቸውና፥ ለማጥፋትም ተፈጥረዋልና አምላኬ ሆይ፥ የእኔን የባሪያህን ልጆች አያጥፉ፤ በሕይወት በሚኖሩ ሰዎች ነፍስም አይሠልጥኑ፥ አንተ ብቻ ፍርዳቸውን ታውቃለህና ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ በጻድቃን ልጆች ላይ አይሠልጥኑ።”

አምላካችንም ሁሉን አስረን እናግዝ ዘንድ አዘዘን። የአጋንንትም አለቃ መስቴማ መጥቶ፥ “አቤቱ ፈጣሪዬ፥ ከእነርሱ በፊቴ ጥቂት አስቀርልኝ፤ ቃሌንም ይስሙ፤ እኔ የማዝዛቸውንም ሁሉ ያድርጉ፤ ከእነርሱ ካልቀሩልኝ በሰው ልጆች ላይ የፈቃዴን ሥልጣን ማድረግ አልችልምና። የሰው ልጆች ክፋታቸው ብዙ ስለ ሆነ ከፍርዴ አስቀድሞ እነርሱ ለማጥፋትና ለማሳት ናቸውና።”
“በፊቱ ዐሥረኛው ነገድ ይቅሩ፤ ዘጠኙን ነገድ ግን ወደ ፍርድ ቦታ ያውርዱአቸው” አለ። እርሱም በቀና ሥራ ጸንተው የሚኖሩ እንዳይደሉ፥ በእውነትም የሚጣሉ እንዳይደሉ ያውቃልና የሚድኑበትን ሁሉ ለኖኅ እናስተምረው ዘንድ ከእኛ አንዱን አዘዘው።
እኛም እንደ ቃሉ አደረግን፤ ፈጽመው የከፉ አጋንንትን በፍርድ ቦታ አስረን አጋዝን። ዐሥረኛውን ነገድ ግን በሰይጣን ፊት በምድር ይገዙ ዘንድ አስቀረን። በምድር እንጨቶችም ያድን ዘንድ የደዌያቸውን መድኀኒት ከማሳታቸው ጋር ለኖኅ ነገርነው።
ኖኅም በየመድኀኒቱ ዓይነት ሁሉ እንዳስተማርነው በመጽሐፍ ሁሉን ጻፈ። ክፉዎች አጋንንትም የኖኅን ልጆች እንዳይከታተሉ ተጋዙ።

ከልጆቹ ሁሉ ይልቅ ፈጽሞ እርሱን ይወደው ነበርና የጻፋቸውን መጻሕፍት ሁሉ ለታላቁ ልጁ ለሴም ሰጠው። ኖኅም እንደ አባቶቹ ሞተ፤ አራራት በሚባልም ሀገር በሉባር ተቀበረ፤ ኖኅም በሕይወቱ ዘጠኝ መቶ አምሳ ዓመት ጨረሰ። ይህም ዐሥራ ዘጠኝ ኢዮቤልዩ ሁለት ሱባዔና አምስት ዓመት ነው። ፍጹም በሆነባት ሥራው በምድር የኖረው ሕይወቱ ከሄኖክ በቀር ከሰው ልጆች ይልቅ የከበረ ነበር። የሄኖክ ሥራ በፍርድ ቀን የትውልዱን ሁሉ ሥራ ይነግር ዘንድ ለዘለዓለም ትውልድ ምስክር ሊሆን ተፈጥሮአልና።

በሠላሳ ሦስተኛው ኢዮቤልዩ ከሁለተኛው ሱባዔ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት ፋሌክ ስምዋ ሎምና የሚባል ሚስትን አገባ፤ ይህችውም የሴናዖር ልጅ ናት። በዚሁም ሱባዔ በአራተኛው ዓመት ወንድ ልጅን ወለደችለት። ከአራራት ምድር ወደ ምሥራቅ ወደ ሰናዖር ሀገር ስለ ተሰደዱ በሰናዖር ሀገር ከተማንና አምባን ይሠሩ ዘንድ የሰው ልጆች በጽኑ ምክር እነሆ፥ ክፉዎችን ሆኑ ብሎአልና ስሙን ራግው አለው። ወደ ሰማይ እንወጣበታለን ሲሉ በዘመኑ ከተማንና ግንብን ሠርተዋልና፤ መሥራትም ጀምረዋልና።

And in the fourth, they took the bricks and burned them with fire. The bricks were like stone to them; and the clay from which they made it was like the dust of the sea, which comes forth from the waters of the sea and the land of Senaar.

And they worked for thirty-four years. They were engaged in their work. And the tower was two hundred and three bricks high; the height of the brick was one-third of its length. Its height was five thousand four hundred and thirty-three cubits, rising from two to above. And the foundation was thirty-three layers.

Our God, the Lord, said to us, "Behold, the people is one and they have one language; and this they begin to do. Now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do. Come, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another's speech; so the Lord scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth, and they left off to build the city."

And the Lord came down; and we, the children of men, beheld the city and the tower which they had built, and we went down with Him; and their language was confounded; so that one did not understand the speech of another. And thereafter they ceased to build the city and the tower.
Therefore, the Lord confounded the language of all the children of men, and the land of Senaar was called Babel; and from thence, in every city and in every language, they were scattered.

And the Lord brought a great wind, and it blew upon the earth, and behold, He was in the land of Senaar, between Assyria and Babylon. And His name was not forgotten. In the thirty-fourth year, in the first year of the tower, they were scattered from the land of Senaar.

And Kamna and his sons went to the land of the south, to the land of the Canaanites. And they beheld the land of Lebanon, which was pleasant, from the river of Egypt to the waters of the sea. And they did not go to the entrance of the sea; for He began from the east to the west in Lebanon and by the sea.

And their father Kamna and his brothers said, "You have dwelt in a land that is not yours; and we have not come out of the land of the Canaanites, and thus do not do this. If you do so, you and your children will perish in this land; for you have dwelt in strife, and you will be consumed in strife; your children will perish, and you will perish forever."

For Shem and his sons have gone to their land, and do not dwell in the land of Shem; for you are the one who is consumed. Before our father Noah and the holy priest, you are set apart from all the sons of Noah." But he did not listen to them; for from his mother to the entrance of Egypt, he dwelt in the land of Lebanon, and his sons dwelt there until this day. Therefore, this land is called the land of Canaan.
And Japheth and his sons went toward the sea; and their portion was in the land that was theirs.

And Maday beheld the land that is by the sea; yet she found no joy before him. For her brothers, who were of Elam and Assyria, and even of Arphaxad, dwelt in the land of Macedonia until this day. He called the place of his dwelling and the place of his children by the name of his father, Maday.
In the thirtieth year of the jubilee, in the third month, in the first year, he took to himself a wife named Ur, who was the daughter of Keseid. And she bore him a son, and he called his name Serg.

In this jubilee, in the seventh month, the sons of Noah began to slay men and to eat flesh, each brother slaying his brother, and shedding man's blood upon the earth, and eating blood. They began to make cities and to build walls, and to make weapons of war, and to teach their children to make war. One nation began to war against another nation, and women and men began to sell themselves.

The son of Keseid, Ur, built the city of Ur in Caldea; and he called her name by his name and by the name of his father. And they made idols; and each one would offer to the idol he had made. They began to make idols and images, and to commit abominations, and they would worship them, and they would serve them.

And the chief was strong to do all these things; to destroy sin and all iniquity, and utterly to destroy every wickedness, and to shed blood upon the earth, as if to say, "Let the hands of the wicked be upon the earth."

Therefore, every man has turned to do wickedness and all sin, and the name of the woman was called Serg. And he was wicked; for he had taken a wife and a mother, and he dwelt in Caldea, and in Ur he lived. He would have made an idol; and in the thirtieth year of the jubilee, in the fifth month, he took a wife; and her name was Melka; she was the daughter of his father’s sister, the daughter of Kaber, and in this month she bore him a son.
He was wicked; for he lived in Ur in Caldea. And his father taught him the signs of heaven for the purpose of divination and for the observation of the stars.

In the thirtieth year of the jubilee, in the sixth month, in the first year, he took a wife; and her name was Ioska. She was of the lineage of the Chaldeans, the daughter of Nesteg. In this month, she bore him a son named Tara.

The chief was strong to destroy the earth; he commanded that the seed which was sown upon the earth be consumed, and he sent forth the fowl and the creeping things. The creeping things would not be able to escape, and the children of men would be consumed from the earth.

And from the fowl, the years began to be few; and they would consume all the fruit of the trees from their branches, and in their time, the fruit of the earth would be scarce, yet they would be strong. In the thirtieth year of the jubilee, in the second month, in the first year, he took a wife named Edna; she was the daughter of his father’s sister, the daughter of Abraham. In this month, she bore him a son. And her son died without a son, and his name was called by the name of his mother’s father, Abraham.
And that son began to know the error of the earth, as he followed the idols and committed sin, like a wife.
His father taught him the scriptures; he was a son of two years and he was separated from his father so that he would not be given to idols.
Let all who are saved from the error of the children of men pray to God, that they may not fall into sin by following the abominations and wickedness.
The time had come to sow seed upon the earth; and they went forth in unity, that they might keep their seed from the Amorites.

And Abram went forth with his children. He was a son of fourteen years; and many gathered to him to sow seed. And Abram, while they were wandering upon the earth, would run before them, saying, "Return to the place whither you have come, and do not depart from the earth." And they returned.
On that day, many gathered men to protect the crops. And Abram, where he was, did not allow even one crop to perish from all the crops.
All the people who were with him in his fields would cry out, and all the Amorites would hear them, saying, "Return!" And they would hear him, for his voice was lifted high upon all the land.

All those who were to be sown would come to him in that year. And until the months of sowing were completed, they would go with him. And they would sow their land; and in that year they would gather the harvest, and they would reap.
And Abram taught the people to prepare wood for the making of the cattle's implements in the first year of the fifth sowing.

And upon the earth, they made implements for the cattle; and upon them, they would carry the seed, and they would work diligently. And the seed would be sown in the furrows, and upon the earth, it would be hidden. And after this, they did not flee from before the Amorites; and in the furrows, they did all things thus, and upon the earth, they would keep the furrows.
And he sowed, and all men did as Abram commanded them. After that, they did not fear the Amorites.

In the sixth month, in the seventh year, Abram called to his father, saying, "Father, my father," and he answered, "Here I am, my son." And he said, "What help or joy can we have from these idols, which have no breath in them, and which you worship before them? They are but mere statues, and they deceive the heart; do not trust in them."

I worship the God of heaven, who created the heavens and the earth, who brings down rain and dew upon the earth, who does all things upon the earth, and who created all things by His word; and life is found in Him alone.

Why do you regard their idols, which have no breath in them? They are the work of man's hands, and you carry them upon your shoulders; they are a great burden to those who make them, yet from them no help can be found, for they are a delusion to those who worship them.

And his father said, "My son, I know; but what shall I do for the people who serve them? If I speak the truth to them, they will turn against me, for their hearts are led astray by them; they will surely destroy me. My son, be silent, lest they destroy you."
And he spoke this matter to his two brothers; and they were silent, but he remained quiet.
In the fortieth year, in the second month, in the seventh year, Abram took a wife; her name was Sarah, and she was the daughter of his father; and she became his wife.

And his brother Nahor also took a wife in the third month, in the third year; and in this month, in the seventh year, she bore him a son, and he named him Lot. And his brother Nahor took a wife as well.
አብራም በሕይወት በኖረበት በስድሳኛው ዓመት፥ ይኸውም በአራተኛው ሱባኤ በአራተኛው ዓመት፥ አብራም ሌሊት ተነሥቶ የጣዖታቱን ቤት አቃጠለ። በቤት ያለውንም ዕቃ ሁሉ አቃጠለ። ያወቀ ሰው ግን አልነበረም።
በሌሊትም ተነሥተው ጣዖቶቻቸውን ከእሳት ውስጥ ያወጡ ዘንድ ወደዱ።
አራንም ያድናቸው ዘንድ ተወረወረ፤ በላዩም እሳት ነደደበት፤ በእሳትም ተቃጥሎ የከላውዴዎን ዕጣ በምትሆን በዑር በአባቱ በታራ ፊት ሞተ። የከላውዴዎን ዕጣ በምትሆን በዑርም ቀበሩት።
ታራም የከላውዴዎን ዕጣ ከምትሆን ከዑር ወጣ። እርሱና ልጆቹ ወደ ሊባኖስ ምድርና ወደ ከነዓን ምድር፥ ወደ ካራንም ምድር ይመጡ ዘንድ ወጣ።
አብራምም ከአባቱ ጋር በካራን ሁለት የዓመቶች ሱባዔ ተቀመጠ።
በስድስተኛው ሱባዔ በአምስተኛው ዓመት አብራም ተነሣ፤ በሰባተኛው ወር መባቻ ከማታ እስከ ጥዋት ድረስ ከዋክብትን ይቈጥር ዘንድና ስለ ዝናም የዓመቱ ጠባይ ምን እንደሚሆን ያይ ዘንድ በሌሊት ወጥቶ ተቀመጠ።
ብቻውንም ተቀምጦ ይቈጥር ነበር፥ ቃልም ወደ ልቡ መጣ፤ “የከዋክብት ምልክት ሁሉ፥ የፀሐይና የጨረቃም ምልክት ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነው። ጥዋትም ማታም ያዘንብ ዘንድ ቢወድ፥ እንዳያዘንብም ቢወድ እኔ ለምን እመራመራለሁ? ሁሉም በእጁ ነው” አለ።

በዚህችም ሌሊት ጸለየ፥ እንዲህም አለ፥ “አምላኬ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ልዑል አምላክ፥ አንተ ብቻ ለእኔ አምላክ ነህ፤ አንተ ሁሉን ፈጠርህ፤ የእጅህ ፍጥረት ሁሉ ጸንቶ ይኖራል፤ እኔ አንተንና መንግሥትህን ወደድሁ፤ ከክፉዎች በሰው ልቡና ከሚሠለጥኑ ከመናፍስት እጅ አድነኝ፤ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ አንተን ከመከተል አያስቱኝ፤ እኔንም ዘሬንም ከዛሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ ለዘለዓለም እንዳንስት አድርገን።
ወደ እነርሱም እመለስ ዘንድ ፊቴን ወደሚሹ ወደ ከላውዴዎን ዑር ልመለስን? ወይስ በዚህ ቦታ ልቀመጥ? ያገለግል ዘንድ በባሪያህ እጅ የቀናውን መንገድ በፊትህ አቅና። አምላኬ ሆይ፥ በልቡናዬ ስሕተት አልሂድ።”
እርሱም ይህን ተናግሮና ጸልዮ በጨረሰ ጊዜ፥ እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በእኔ እጅ እንዲህ ሲል ወደ እርሱ ተላከ፥ “አንተ ከሀገርህ፥ ከዘመዶችህና ከአባትህ ቤት ወጥተህ እኔ ወደማሳይህ ሀገር ሂድ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ወገን አደርግሃለሁ፤ እባርክህማለሁ፤ ስምህንም ከፍ ከፍ አደርጋለሁ፤ በምድሩም ሁሉ የተባረክህ ትሆናለህ።

"All the nations of the earth shall bless you; I shall bless those who bless you, and I shall curse those who curse you. I shall be God to you and to your children, to your children's children, and to all your descendants; from you and henceforth, from this day until the generation of your children's children, I am your God; do not be afraid."
"The Lord God said to me, 'From the day of the fall, the language of every son of man has been separated, and let him open his mouth and ears to hear and speak the language that has been revealed.'"

"And I opened my mouth and ears; I began to speak with him in the language of my ancestors, in the Hebrew tongue; I took the book of my fathers, and those were written in the Hebrew language. Moreover, I wrote them; from that day forth, they began to learn. I used to tell them all that I had learned; the rain also taught them in the six months."
"In the sixth year of the seventh month, it came to pass; he spoke with his father; he went from Haran to Canaan and did not see him until he returned to him."

"His father said to him, 'Go in peace; may the God of peace keep your path; may the Lord be with you; may He protect you from all evil; may He grant you kindness and forgiveness before the eyes of those who see you; may He give you love; and may no son of man lay a hand upon you to do evil; go in peace.'"

"And for her to dwell, when you see the land that is pleasant to your eyes, come to me; for you shall be a son to me, and you shall bring your brother's son Lot with you; may the Lord be with you; until you return in peace, let your brother be a stranger to me; we all shall go together in unity with you."

"Abram took his wife Sarai and his brother's son Lot and went from Haran to Canaan. He came to Shur; until he returned to Sekimon, he turned back; he settled under a great oak; from the entrance of his mother, he traveled until he reached the land where it was very pleasant; behold, he saw."
"And the Lord said, 'To you and to your children, I shall give this land.' And there he built an altar; he offered sacrifices upon the altar to the Lord who had appeared to him."

"Then he arose and went toward the west, and he went to Bethel; and toward the east, he went to Ai; and there he pitched his tent; and at that time, behold, the land was wide; it was very pleasant; all was flourishing upon it; and wine, and oil, and grain, and all the fruits of the earth were abundant; the water was upon the mountain."
"And the fruit of the land was as sweet as honey; and he brought it to this mountain, and I gave thanks to the Lord."

And it came to pass in the seventh month, in the first year, in the first month, that this was done. There he built an altar; and he called upon the name of the Lord, saying, “O Lord, Thou art my God; Thou art the God of the everlasting ages.” May the Lord dwell with him, that in all the days of his life he may not be separated from Him, and he offered thereon a sacrifice unto the Lord.
And he arose and went southward; and he came unto Hebron. Now Hebron was built at that time. And he dwelt there two years. And Lot also went with him until he came to the land of the south.

And the earth was barren; and Abram went down to Egypt in this seventh month, in the third year, and his wife remained with him, and he dwelt in Egypt five years. The portion of Egypt, which was then, was built seven years after he departed from Hebron.
And it came to pass when Pharaoh took Abram's wife Sarai, that the Lord plagued Pharaoh with great plagues for Sarai's sake; and He afflicted all his house with sore plagues.

And Abram was very rich in silver, and in cattle, and in sheep, and in oxen, and in menservants and maidservants, and in she-asses and in horses; he was exceedingly wealthy. And Lot, the son of his brother, was also rich in cattle like unto him.

And Pharaoh restored Sarai, Abram's wife. And he arose from Egypt and went to Bethel, between the east and the west, unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning, unto the place of the altar which he had made there at the first.
And the Lord who returned him in peace, Abram gave thanks unto God.

And it came to pass in the forty-first year, in the first month, in the third year, that he returned to this place; and he offered a sacrifice in the altar, and he called upon the name of the Lord, saying, “O Lord God, Thou art the Most High God, my God for ever and ever.”

And in this seventh month, in the fourth year, Lot separated from him; and he dwelt in Sodom. But the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners. And because he was separated from his brother, Lot's heart was grieved. And Lot had no son in that year.

And after Lot had separated from him, in this seventh month, in the fourth year, the Lord said unto Abram, “Lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward and southward, and eastward and westward; for all the land which thou seest, to thee and to thy seed will I give it for ever.”
ልጆችህንም እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ አደርጋለሁ፤ ሰው የባሕር አሸዋን መቍጠር ይችል እንደ ሆነ ልጆችህም ይቈጠራሉ፤ ተነሥተህ ቁመቷንና ወርድዋን ዙራት፤ ሁሉንም ተመልከት፤ ለልጆችህ እሰጣታለሁና።”
አብራምም ወደ ኬብሮን ሄደ፤ በዚያም ተቀመጠ።
በዚያም ዓመት የኤላም ንጉሥ ኮሎዶጎሞር መጣ፤ የሰናዖርም ንጉሥ አምራፌል፥ የሲላሳር ንጉሥ አሪኦክ፥ የአሕዛብ ንጉሥም ቲርጋል መጡ፤ የገሞራንም ንጉሥ ወጉት።

የሰዶም ንጉሥ ግን ሸሸ፤ በጨው ባሕር በኩል በሲዲም ሸለቆ ብዙ ሰዎች በጦር ቈስለው ወደቁ፤ ሰዶምንና አዳማን ሴቦኢምንም ማረኩ፤ የአብራምን የወንድሙን ልጅ ሎጥንም ማረኩ፤ ገንዘቡንም ሁሉ ዘረፉ፤ እስከ ዳንም ድረስ ሄደ። ከጦር ያመለጠ አንድ ሰውም መጥቶ የወንድሙ ልጅ ሎጥ እንደ ተማረከ ለአብራም ነገረው። አሽከሮቹንም አስታጠቀ።
ከቀዳምያት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ዐሥራትን እንዲሰጡ በአብርሃምና በልጆቹ ሥርዐት ተሠራ። እግዚአብሔርም ለዘለዓለም ይይዙት ዘንድ በፊቱ ለሚያገለግሉ ለካህናቱ እንዲሰጡአቸው የዘለዓለም ሥርዐትን ሠራ።
ከሁሉም ከእህሉም፥ ከወይኑም፥ ከዘይቱም፥ ከላሞችም፥ ከበጎችም፥ ከፍየሎችም ለእግዚአብሔር ዐሥራት ይሰጡ ዘንድ ለልጅ ልጅ ለዘለዓለም ሠርቶታልና ለዚህ ሕግ የተወሰነ ዘመን የለውም።
እርሱም በፊት ደስ ብሎአቸው ሊበሉትና ሊጠጡት ለካህናት ሰጠ።
የሰዶምም ንጉሥ ወደ እርሱ ደረሰ፤ በፊቱም ሰገደ፥ “ጌታችን አብራም ሆይ ፥ ያዳንኸውን ሰው ስጠን፤ ምርኮው ግን ለአንተ ይሁንልህ” አለው።
አብራምም፥ “እኔ አብራምን አበለጸግሁት የምትል እንዳትሆን፥ ጐልማሶች ከበሉት በቀር ከአንተ ገንዘብ ሁሉ የክር ፈትልና የጫማ ጠፍር እንዳልወስድ ገናና ወደ ሆነ አምላኬ እኔ እጆችን አነሣለሁ፤ ነገር ግን ከእኔ ጋር የሄዱ ሰዎች አውናንና ኤሴኬል፥ መምሬም እነርሱ ፈንታቸውን ይውሰዱ” አለው።
After these things, in the fourth year of this Suba, in the third month, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Fear not, Abram; I am your shield; your reward shall be very great.”
And he said, “O Lord God, what will You give me? For I continue childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus.”
And he said, “This man shall not be your heir; your very own son shall be your heir.”

And he brought him outside and said, “Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them.” Then he said to him, “So shall your offspring be.” And he believed the Lord, and he counted it to him as righteousness.
“To dwell forever, may it be so.”
And he said, “O Lord God, how am I to know that I shall possess it?”
He said, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, and a ram three years old, and a turtle dove and a young pigeon.”

He brought him all these, cut them in half, and laid each half over against the other; but he did not cut the birds in half. And the birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram; and behold, dreadful and great darkness fell upon him.
But Abram drove them away; and the birds of prey did not come near the sacrifice.
ፀሐይም በገባ ጊዜ እንዲህ ሆነ፥ በአብራም እንቅልፍ መጣበት ፤ እነሆም፥ የሚያስፈራ ጽኑ ጨለማ በላዩ ወደቀበት።
ለአብራምም እንዲህ ተብሎ ተነገረ፥ “ዘርህ በአሕዛብ ሀገር ስደተኞች እንደሚሆኑ፥ አራት መቶ ዓመትም እንደሚገዙአቸውና መከራ እንደሚያጸኑባቸው ፈጽመህ ዕወቅ፤ የሚገዙአቸውንም ወገኖች እኔ እፈርድባቸዋለሁ።
ከዚህ በኋላ ከብዙ ገንዘብ ጋር ከዚያ ይወጣሉ። አንተም ወደ አባቶችህ በሰላም ትሄዳለህ፤ በበጎ እርግናም ትቀበራለህ።
በአራተኛው ትውልድ ወደዚህ ይመለሳሉ፤ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የአሞራውያን ኀጢአት አልተፈጸመምና።”
ከእንቅልፉም ነቅቶ ተነሣ፤ ፀሐይም ገባ፤ እሳትም ይነድ ጀመር፤ እነሆ፥ ምድጃው እየጤሰ የእሳቱ ነበልባል በመሠዊያው መካከል አለፈ።

በዚያችም ሌሊት እግዚአብሔር ከአብራም ጋር እንዲህ ሲል ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ፥ “ከግብፅ ወንዝ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ወንዝ፤ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ ድረስ፥ ይህችን ሀገር ለልጆችህ እሰጣለሁ፤ የቄኔዎስንና የቄኔዜዎስን፥ የቀድሞኔዎስን፥ የፌርዜዎስንና የራፋይምን፥ የፌኮሬዎስን፥ የኤዌዎስንና የአሞሬዎስን፥ የከናኔዎስንና የጌርጌሴዎስን፥ የኢያቡሴዎስንም ሀገር እሰጥሀለሁ።”
አብራምም ሄዶ መሠዊያውን አዘጋጀ፤ አዕዋፍንና መሥዋዕታቸውን፥ ወይናቸውንም አቀረበ፤ እሳትም በላው።
በዚያችም ወር ከኖኅ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን እንደ አደረግን በዚችም ዕለት ከአብራም ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረግን።
አብራምም ይህችን በዓልና ሥርዐቷንም እስከ ዘለዓለም ድረስ ለራሱ አጸናት፤ አብራምም ደስ አለው፤ ይህንም ነገር ሁሉ ለሚስቱ ለሶራ ነገራት፤ ልጅ እንደሚወለድለትም አመነ። እርስዋ ግን ልጅ አትወልድም ነበር፤ ሶራም ባልዋን አብራምን መከረችው፦
አብራምም የሚስቱ የሶራን ቃል ሰማ፥ “እንዳልሽ አድርጊ” አላት። ሶራም ግብፃዊት አገልጋይዋን አጋርን አምጥታ ሚስት ትሆነው ዘንድ ለባልዋ ለአብርሃም ሰጠቻት።
And she entered unto her, and she conceived, and bore a son. And he called his name Ishmael in the fifth year of this jubilee. And in that year, the age of Abram was eighty-six years.
In this jubilee, in the fourth week, in the fifth year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, Abram made a feast for the harvest, a celebration of the wheat harvest.

And he offered the first of the flour in the sanctuary, a new offering unto the Lord; and the firstlings of the flock, and the fat thereof, he offered as a burnt offering unto the Lord upon the altar. And he offered their offerings and their libations with fine wine.
And the Lord appeared unto Abram, and said, "I am the Almighty God; walk before Me, and be thou perfect; and I will make My covenant between Me and thee, and I will multiply thee exceedingly."
And Abram fell on his face; and God spoke unto him, saying, "Behold, My covenant is with thee, and thou shalt be a father of many nations."

Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram, but thy name shall be Abraham; for a father of many nations have I made thee. And I will make thee exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of thee, and kings shall come out of thee.
And I will establish My covenant between Me and thee, and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God unto thee, and to thy seed after thee.

And God said unto Abraham, "Thou shalt keep My covenant, thou, and thy seed after thee in their generations. This is My covenant, which ye shall keep, between Me and you and thy seed after thee; every male among you shall be circumcised."
And in the eighth day, shall ye circumcise every male among you throughout your generations, he that is born in the house, or bought with money of any stranger, which is not of thy seed.

And My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant. And the uncircumcised male child, whose flesh of his foreskin is not circumcised, that soul shall be cut off from his people; he hath broken My covenant.
እግዚአብሔርም አብርሃምን እንዲህ አለው፥ “ሚስትህ ሶራ ስምዋ ሳራ ነውና ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ ስምዋ ሶራ ተብሎ አይጠራ፤ እባርካታለሁ፤ ከእርስዋም ልጅ እሰጥሃለሁ፤ እርሱንም እባርከዋለሁ፤ ታላቅ ወገንም ይሆናል፤ የአሕዛብ ነገሥታትም ከእርሱ ይወለዳሉ።”
አብርሃምም በግንባሩ ወደቀ። ደስ ብሎትም በልቡ እንዲህ አለ፥ “በመቶ ዘመኔ ልጅ እወልዳለሁን? ዘጠና ዓመት የሆናት ሳራስ ልጅ ትወልዳለችን?”
አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ አለው፥ “ይስማኤል በፊትህ ቢኖር በወደድሁ ነበር።”
እግዚአብሔርም አለው፥ “ይሁን፥ ሳራም ወንድ ልጅን ትወልድልሃለች፤ ስሙንም ይስሐቅ ብለህ ትጠራዋለህ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔንም የዘለዓለም ቃል ኪዳን ሊሆን ከእርሱ ጋር አጸናለሁ፤ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለልጆቹ አጸናለሁ።
ስለ ይስማኤልም ሰማሁህ፤ እነሆ፥ እባርከዋለሁ፥ አገነዋለሁ፤ እጅግም አበዛዋለሁ፤ ዐሥራ ሁለት መሳፍንትንም ይወልዳል፤ በታላቅም ሕዝብ ላይ እሾመዋለሁ።
ቃል ኪዳኔን ግን በዚህ ወራት በሁለተኛው ዓመት ሳራ ከምትወልድልህ ከይስሐቅ ጋር አጸናለሁ።” ከእርሱም ጋር ይህን ተናግሮ ከጨረሰ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር አብርሃም ካለበት ወጣ።
አብርሃምም እግዚአብሔር እንዳለው አደረገ፤ ልጁ ይስማኤልንና በቤት የተወለደውን ሁሉ፥ በወርቁ የገዛውንም፥ በቤቱም ያለ ወንድ ልጅን ሁሉ ወስዶ የሰውነታቸውን ሰንኮፍ ገረዘ።
በዚህችም ቀን አብርሃም ተገረዘ፤ ቤተ ሰቦቹም፥ በወርቅ የገዛቸውም ሁሉ፥ ከአሕዛብም የተወለዱ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገረዙ። ይህም ሕግ ለልጅ ልጅ ሁሉ የዘለዓለም ነው።
ይህ የዘለዓለም ሥርዐት ነውና፥ በሰማይ ጽላትም ተጽፎአልና ቀን ማሳጠር የለም፤ ከስምንቱ ቀንም አንዲት ቀን መተላለፍ የለም።
እስከ ስምንት ቀንም ድረስ የሰውነቱን ሰንኮፍ ያልተገረዘ ሰው ሁሉ ከጥፋት ልጆች ወገን ነውና እግዚአብሔር ለአብርሃም ከገባው ቃል ኪዳን ልጆች ወገን አይደለም።

There shall be no sign for the Lord; for our God, the Lord, has made a covenant, which He has established to destroy and to bring to ruin the earth, and it is fitting that He should be removed from the earth. All the angels of heaven and all the angels of praise, from the day they were created, have been made thus.
And in the presence of the angels of heaven and the angels of praise, they shall be sanctified together with Him and with the holy angels.

And you shall command the children of Israel; they shall keep this covenant as a sign; and it shall be an everlasting ordinance for their children; it shall be kept for all the children of Israel, so that they may not perish from the earth, for it has been established as a covenant.
